info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Ratings-v4-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Ratings API allows users to access and review delivery ratings for food deliveries. This endpoint provides a comprehensive list of ratings, enabling consumers to evaluate delivery services based on customer feedback. Typical users include food delivery platforms, restaurants, and logistics providers looking to enhance service quality and customer satisfaction. By leveraging these insights, businesses can make informed decisions to improve their delivery processes and customer experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the rating of a specific delivery. You may use this information to assess the quality of service provided during the delivery process.

requestBody.description: This request body accepts a JSON object that contains the details necessary for retrieving the rating of deliveries.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesRatingsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations related to deliveries and ratings. It is expected to receive a string value that can include relevant information or parameters relevant to the operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the delivery.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the delivery rating operation.

state.description: The current state of the delivery rating operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the delivery rating operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the delivery rating operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the delivery rating operation.
